g.text: Can the model tell when it is wrong?

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Yes, on this data. Both uncertainty measures correlate strongly with error (entropy ρ=-0.731, pass-disagreement ρ=-0.763).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: experiments/exp004_uncertainty_failure (E1). Porcine intraoperative data: this validates the uncertainty mechanism, not any clinical safety property.
